chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade mixing milk with water for the purpose of sale.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on mixing water with milk for sale?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on trade ethics, this hadith specifies the prohibition of adulterating milk with water for sale, illustrating the broader Islamic principle of *gharar* (uncertainty) and *ghish* (deception) in commercial transactions. It underscores the Prophet’s emphasis on maintaining quality and transparency to protect consumers from hidden defects, a key concern in Shia jurisprudence regarding market integrity.
